card.name: The word for before a purpose noun
card.fires_on: The word "for" (or the start of the noun right after it) when text says something is prepared, submitted or put forward for a purpose, such as review, publication, storage or nomination.

modes.label: for + purpose
modes.description: The word "for" after a verb like prepared, sent or put forward, just before a purpose noun.
modes.example: This material was prepared<< for>> Religion Online by Ted and Winnie Brock

modes.label: Purpose noun itself
modes.description: The purpose noun or its first part right after "for", such as review, storage or publication.
modes.example: your modifications will be sent to our editors for<< review>>.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward abstract action nouns such as publication, execution, inclusion and implementation.
card.plain: It lights up when text says something is made or sent "for" a purpose, like review, publication or storage.
